scope: Current KV-cache project attention and five source-only debugging opportunities; no new reproduction or selected case.

issues.title: Async prefetch repeats reads of GPU-resident prefix
issues.title_zh: 异步预取重复读取 GPU 已有的前缀
issues.coroperf_assessment_zh: PR3540 已关闭但未合并；base 的异步 prefetch 未接收 num_computed_tokens。MP 模式修复不能证明经典路径已修复。增量是按请求、Task、chunk 区间和实际读取字节量化冗余，调用栈不能独立判定 GPU 驻留。
issues.required_observations: request_id / Task identity / chunk key / token interval / backend read bytes

issues.title: Lookup pin remains when retrieval is skipped
issues.title_zh: lookup 命中后跳过 retrieve，pin 未释放
issues.coroperf_assessment_zh: 更贴合资源生命周期归因：追踪是哪次 lookup/请求留下 pin，并定位缺失的 unpin。共享块需记录多 owner 与 pin 状态变化，不能只用 Task 创建树推断。
issues.required_observations: request_id / memory-object identity / pin-unpin events / lookup and retrieval decision

issues.title: Dropped TCP pump and missing receive-failure notification
issues.title_zh: TCP pump 漏投后传输不推进；接收失败未发布请求完成
issues.coroperf_assessment_zh: 旧版源码和修复提交支持拒绝分支漏投 pump；不再将最初的 CLOSED 组解释当作定论。vLLM 0.29.0 的失败响应只记日志，成功响应才递减接收计数并发布完成。需将请求、receiver Task、transfer/batch 和完成状态关联，不能把 Task 已结束等同于请求已完成。未运行原始 PD 场景。
issues.required_observations: request_id / receiver Task / transfer_id and batch / pull counter / terminal notification / native group and pump epoch

issues.title: Busy-wait during transfer completion
issues.title_zh: 传输完成等待忙轮询占用 CPU
issues.coroperf_assessment_zh: 历史 PR1053 合并了事件驱动等待，但 USE_EVENT_DRIVEN_COMPLETION 默认 OFF，仍保留轮询。普通 CPU profiler 已能定位热点；需要实际 transfer/batch 到请求归属才有 CoroPerf 增量，当前未验证。该结论不代表当前 wheel 的编译配置。
issues.required_observations: operation-state identity / batch_id / submitting Task / completion status

issues.title: Disk-to-device KV onboarding stalls
issues.title_zh: KVBM 从磁盘回载到设备时等待不结束
issues.coroperf_assessment_zh: 后续日志已有 NIXL 无可用 backend 错误及 request/operation/message ID。v0.7.0 源码会标记传输成功或失败，并对两者 ACK；需区分 ACK、传输 Result 和请求 slot 完成，不能仅凭等待日志推断磁盘阻塞。软件绑定不齐，尚未运行。
issues.required_observations: request_id / KV block identity / migration Task / disk and transfer completion

caution: Closed because of inactivity does not establish a fix. CoroPerf contributions are proposals requiring stable task/resource identity observations, not already verified capabilities.
